gaps.message: runtime_multi_node_observation: resource_profile need process access; inside the package they are reported unavailable.

primitives.note: Node images are pinned in the package compose; the primitive reads install-report.json shipped with the package.
Antithesis starts the compose; the primitive reads the package-shipped runtime.json and compose-report.json.
N2N mux flood over the compose network; liveness by TCP connect (F175 A2).
Cardano tips are read with cardano-cli over the mounted node socket and Amaru tips from the mounted node log; connection state is reported unavailable (no process access inside the package).
Antithesis owns the compose lifecycle; the primitive records a delegated teardown.
